title: Juicy Salted Malai Fish Stir-fry
description: A flavorful and juicy dish featuring malai (Indian-style cheese) in a monsoon-inspired recipe that's perfect for pescatarian diets.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan and sauté onions until translucent.
Add garlic and chili peppers, cooking for about 1 minute until fragrant.
Gently blanch fish fillets in the onion mixture for about 2 minutes on each side or until golden brown.
Pour in enough water to cover the fish, bring to a boil then reduce heat, allowing it to simmer for about 5-7 minutes.
Stir in malai, cooking until it has fully melted and infused with flavors.
